services.name: api-ingest
services.purpose: Receives incoming API requests and publishes ingest events to the message queue.

services.name: api-alb
services.purpose: Distributes incoming HTTPS traffic to the api-ingest service.

services.name: ingest-worker
services.purpose: Consumes messages from the queue, transforms data, and loads it into the data warehouse.

services.name: monitoring-prometheus
services.purpose: Collects metrics from API and worker services for observability.

services.name: monitoring-grafana
services.purpose: Visualizes metrics and dashboards for the pipeline components.

dependencies.description: Routes incoming HTTP requests to the ingest API service.
Publishes ingest events consumed asynchronously by worker service via the queue.
Scrapes metrics endpoint exposed by the API ingest service.
Scrapes metrics endpoint exposed by the worker service.
Queries Prometheus as a data source for dashboards.

network.notes: API ALB is the only public entry point. Worker and monitoring services run in private subnets with no direct internet exposure. Outbound internet access for workers (e.g., to warehouse endpoint) is via NAT gateway.

ambiguities.detail: Description did not specify how API and worker services should be deployed (containers, VMs, serverless).
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed ECS Fargate for both API and worker services to minimize infrastructure management.

ambiguities.detail: Description mentioned a message queue without specifying the type (SQS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed Amazon SQS as a fully managed, low-maintenance queue service.

ambiguities.detail: Description mentioned a data warehouse without specifying the engine.
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed Amazon Redshift as the AWS-native data warehouse solution.

ambiguities.detail: No mention of whether raw ingested events should be persisted before/after processing.
ambiguities.assumption: Added an S3 bucket for raw event storage as a staging/backup layer, attached to both API and worker services.

ambiguities.detail: Description did not mention observability or monitoring requirements.
ambiguities.assumption: Added Prometheus and Grafana as managed services for basic metrics visibility.

ambiguities.detail: Description did not specify VPC, subnet layout, or public/private exposure requirements.
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed a single VPC with public ALB and private subnets for all backend services, using a NAT gateway for outbound access.

ambiguities.detail: No AWS region, instance sizing, or scaling parameters were specified.
ambiguities.assumption: Left region and sizing unspecified at the architecture level; to be defined in Terraform variables during implementation.

ambiguities.detail: Description did not specify how HTTPS termination or certificates should be handled.
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed ALB terminates TLS using an ACM-managed certificate.
